The setup test mock declares the fetch parameters inspected by its negative assertion. No additional test was needed for these type-narrowing changes; existing setup, offer and routing suites cover the relevant behavior.

Correcting the route metadata import exposed readonly-array and undeclared-field mismatches in the parity fixture. It now uses satisfies HelixAskRouteMetadata with the existing typed Realtime grounded-feedback binding; synthetic top-level handoff fields are replaced by the actual binding shape. Both payload binding names are asserted, including provenance and non-authoritative flags. No production metadata contract was widened.
